part.text:
Implemented the fix in `hooks/src/index.js`:

- Cleanup handlers are cleared before invocation so a throwing cleanup isn’t called twice during unmount.
- All pending/unmount cleanups now run even if one throws, then the first error is propagated to the nearest error boundary.

Validation: targeted `useEffect` test and full hooks browser suite pass (`86 passed, 1 skipped`). ESLint reports only 3 pre-existing unused-symbol errors unrelated to this change.
